about.title: About Iraqee
about.missionDesc: To build the definitive digital ecosystem for the Iraqi diaspora — directory, marketplace, events, and mediation — owned by the community, not shareholders.
about.visionDesc: Every Iraqi abroad has a digital home where they can find community, opportunity, and connection to Iraq.
about.structureDesc: Iraqee operates as a Canadian Not-for-Profit Corporation — a non-profit entity dedicated to community benefit. All profits are reinvested into the platform and its mission to serve the Iraqi diaspora worldwide.
about.teamMember1Bio: Iraqi-British civil engineer building Iraqee to connect the Iraqi diaspora worldwide. Bridge engineer at Ground Control, creator of @iraqimajles (18K+ subscribers).
about.teamMember2Bio: Leading marketing strategy and community growth for Iraqee. Building bridges between Iraqis worldwide through authentic connection and storytelling.
about.teamMessage: Founded by two Iraqis with a shared vision — one building the technology, the other building the community. Together with Maryan's team, we're creating a digital home for every Iraqi abroad.
